sentences.text: Western District Health Service reported for the year ending 30 June 2026 on acute, aged care and community services in rural western Victoria.
The Service reported merging voluntarily with Casterton Memorial Hospital on 1 April 2026, bringing clinical, governance, workforce and administrative systems together.
sentences.section: Message from The C hairs and C hief Executive

sentences.text: The Service reported progressing plans for its Hamilton emergency department redevelopment and beginning another stage of redevelopment at Penshurst.
sentences.section: Message from The C hairs and C hief Executive

sentences.text: The Service reported delivering 10,061 weighted activity units against a patient activity target of 10,077.
The Service reported an operating surplus of $385,000 against a $98,000 budget target, and an overall net deficit of $6.615 million.

items.quote: For 2025-26, WDHS achieved a modest net operating surplus of $385,000 on total revenue of $143.528m, exceeding the budgeted surplus target of $98,000.
